title: What if the universe has a hidden speed limit faster than light?
angle: Exploring the mind-bending physics of cosmic inflation and warp bubbles to reveal why empty space itself isn't bound by the speed of light, and what that means for our cosmic horizon.
pillar: Mysteries of science and the universe
description: An engaging, scientifically accurate 8-10 minute science explainer exploring how cosmic inflation and warp bubbles prove empty space isn't bound by the speed of light.
